# 六六（Leo-Leo）头像生成记录

Built-in ImageGen, generation with five user-supplied photographic identity references. One call. PNG: `leo-leo-expressions.png`, 2172 × 724, transparent. Web derivative: `leo-leo-expressions.webp`, 972 × 324, transparent. Left to right: attentive, delighted, curious. Original reference photos are not included in the published site.

This revision replaces the generic coach in the teaching prototype; previous assets remain available. Small-scale asset inspection completed. The result retains some fur texture and a larger light muzzle than the intended flat style; future character refinement can simplify those further.

## Exact prompt

```text
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE transparent 3:1 horizontal expression sprite sheet for the Chinese card-game teaching coach 六六 (Leo-Leo).
Input images: All five attached photographs are identity references of the same actual pet cat Leo-Leo. In photo 5 ONLY the foreground brown tabby is Leo-Leo: completely ignore the background cat. Photo 1 shows goofy personality; photos 2, 3 and 5 show face structure and markings; photo 4 shows the curious head tilt.
Primary request: Translate this SPECIFIC cat into a simple clean flat cartoon avatar, recognizable as Leo-Leo, in three equal square cells. Produce one horizontal PNG with genuine transparent alpha, preferably 1536x512 or exact 3:1. Three expressions of one identical character, not candidate designs.
Character identity: warm earthy brown short-haired adult tabby; dark brown, almost black nose, NEVER pink; golden yellow to olive eyes with large dark pupils, NEVER bright green; rounded full cheeks gently tapering to a small chin, not a fluffy ruff. Tall upright ears with dark outer rims and restrained pinkish-gray interiors. Narrow central dark forehead M and vertical strokes, dark eye outlines and outer eye stripes, two sweeping curved dark cheek stripes. Warm tan muzzle with a SMALL lighter chin, never a big white muzzle or bib. Little dark whisker-root dots. Preserve these specific identifying markings and proportions across all three heads.
Expressions left to right: (1) attentive friendly, big alert eyes and small soft smile; (2) delighted smiling with closed crescent eyes and a small open happy mouth, endearingly goofy but gentle; (3) curious with a mild head tilt like photo 4, mildly puzzled yet supportive, soft smile and alert eyes, never angry or sad.
Style: simple clean bold flat-shape cartoon compatible with a light flat card-game UI and readable as a 54px avatar. Few solid colors, smooth rounded strong dark contours, large simple shape patches. Keep the cat's identity while simplifying the photographs aggressively. NO realistic fur detail, brush texture, shading, gradients, shine, 3D, or shadows.
Composition: Head only in every cell, no neck, body, paws, collar, clothes, props, or accessories. Same size and facial proportions in each cell, centered consistently with generous safe transparent padding around the full head including ears and whiskers. All silhouettes fully inside their own equal square cells. The third head may rotate slightly for the tilt but must preserve scale and markings. No visible cell separators, background, border, frame, badge, text, labels, or watermark. True transparency, not a checkerboard drawing.
```
